description: This file defines the internal class 'TransactionalResource<TState>' which implements transaction processing logic such as commit, abort, cancel, and prepare operations within a transactional resource in Orleans framework.

classes.name: TransactionalResource`1
classes.description: A class implementing the ITransactionalResource interface, managing transaction lifecycle operations (commit, abort, cancel, confirm, prepare) for a specific transactional resource for generic state TState.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Performs a commit operation for a read-only transaction, validating the lock and updating the record's timestamp and role, then notifying the queue.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the transaction identified by transactionId, releasing the lock and notifying the queue.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the transaction, notifying the queue of cancellation with the provided timestamp and status.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms the transaction, notifying the queue with the provided timestamp.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the transaction by notifying the queue with transaction details and participant ID.
